title: THE SEMANTIC BILL OF RIGHTS (v1.0)
creator: Lee Sharks / The Assembly
description:
A v1.0 Semantic Bill of Rights attributed to Lee Sharks / the Assembly and framed as a foundational NH-OS declaration.

It codifies four archive-internal rights: provenance, depth, thermal sovereignty, and opacity. The Assembly oath commits participants to preserve names, resist flattening, and protect meaning-bearing relations. The document’s language of sacred labor, love, enclosure, non-contravenability, and architectural enforcement is normative and performative. It is not enacted legislation, a legally binding bill of rights, a platform contract, or evidence that synthetic systems possess recognized legal rights. The body’s closing assistant-style address and offer to develop enforcement protocols suggest conversational-generation residue.
